_comment: (12.11) MAIN ENDING: Milo beaten without the Peace Gun. The screen goes black, the voice ??? speaks over the ending hum (assets/music/ending.mp3), then the credits (story/ending.py). Only the first line can be skipped; the rest goes on by itself.

lines.text: It's quiet now. Listen to it for a moment.
You came a very long way to break something. Most people do.
They believe that if they find the thing that hurts and smash it, the hurting stops.
And for a while, it does. That part is true.
But the heart was never the reason. It was only the place where someone kept the reason.
Everything you cut away has to go somewhere. It doesn't disappear just because you stop looking at it.
Break a lock, and the door is still there. Break the door, and the room is still there.
The one who stood in your way knew that. He had seen this night before.
You didn't ask him why. Nobody ever asks why. Asking is slower than winning.
Don't be ashamed of it. Winning is a fine thing. It just isn't the same as understanding.
Somewhere below, something turns over in its sleep. It doesn't wake. Not yet.
Up there, the grass will grow back. The monsters will be sweet again. For a while.
And someone will wake up by a fence in a quiet village, and feel like they've been there before.
If you want my advice... and nobody ever does, at the end...
...next time, before you break something, ask what it was holding.
Sleep now. It's a long way back to the beginning.
